# Assignment Venue Center

Official website: https://assignmentvenuecentre.me

Assignment Venue Center is an India-based manpower sourcing and recruitment coordination business headquartered in Darbhanga, Bihar. The company supports candidate sourcing, recruitment coordination, agent coordination, employer demand intake, document readiness, visa process support, GAMCA/Wafid medical request support, travel coordination, and public recruitment tools.

Important compliance wording:
- Assignment Venue Center presents public workflows as sourcing, documentation, and recruitment coordination support.
- Any license-specific or government-authorized recruitment claim should be verified separately through official records and applicable documents.
- Public pages should not describe the company with exaggerated or unsupported claims.
- MSME/Udyam registration is not the same as an overseas recruitment RA licence. Users should verify the stated Udyam number on the official Udyam portal and verify any RA licence claim on eMigrate.
